title: Clean and Safe Spaces (CLASS) Parks Youth Employment Internship – Juvenile
text:
Clean and Safe Spaces (CLASS) Parks Youth Employment Internship – Juvenile
  Justice Crime Prevention Act After-School Enrichment and Supervision Program

summary: Accepts grant funds for the CLASS Parks youth employment internship, a juvenile justice crime prevention after-school program, for fiscal year 2026-2027.
